parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-02, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for the given vertical electrical sounding (VES) station, we first list the resistivities of the six layers:

1. $\rho_1 = 31374.7$ $\Omega\text{m}$
2. $\rho_2 = 7559.9$ $\Omega\text{m}$
3. $\rho_3 = 3573.3$ $\Omega\text{m}$
4. $\rho_4 = 313.2$ $\Omega\text{m}$
5. $\rho_5 = 53.6$ $\Omega\text{m}$
6. $\rho_6 = 22.8$ $\Omega\text{m}$

Next, we examine each group of three consecutive layers to identify the curve letter based on the provided rules:
- **Group 1 (Layers 1-2-3):** $31374.7 > 7559.9 > 3573.3 \rightarrow \rho_1 > \rho_2 > \rho_3$ corresponds to **Q**.
- **Group 2 (Layers 2-3-4):** $7559.9 > 3573.3 > 313.2 \rightarrow \rho_2 > \rho_3 > \rho_4$ corresponds to **Q**.
- **Group 3 (Layers 3-4-5):** $3573.3 > 313.2 > 53.6 \rightarrow \rho_3 > \rho_4 > \rho_5$ corresponds to **Q**.
- **Group 4 (Layers 4-5-6):** $313.2 > 53.6 > 22.8 \rightarrow \rho_4 > \rho_5 > \rho_6$ corresponds to **Q**.

The sequence of letters for the 6-layer model is QQQQ. According to the rule "If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter," the notation can be simplified to Q.

{"curve_type": "Q"}
